options.text: She buys the bag, because her ₹1,000 is the same ₹1,000 it was a year ago.
She buys the bag and has change left, because the shop wants to clear its old stock.
She is about ₹60 short, because the bag costs more and her money stayed the same.
The bag costs less than ₹1,000, because it has been in the shop for a whole year.
